_about: Figshare items for the five English transport maps (owner, 6 Nov 2026: evergreen, kept current by scripts/figshare.mjs). Each item holds the live SVG and a PNG rendered from it. articleId null = not created yet: run the script once by hand with CREATE=1 and write the new id here.

items.title: Laos transport map: bus routes, the Laos–China Railway and border crossings
description: Map of how to travel in and out of Laos: long-distance bus routes, the Laos–China Railway with its stations, airports and every international border crossing with Thailand, Vietnam, Cambodia and China, numbered and keyed. Checked every week against the official Lao Department of Immigration register and operator timetables; positions from OpenStreetMap. A new version is published here whenever the map changes.
Free to share under CC BY 4.0: credit "Laos Bus Tickets (laosbustickets.com)" with a link to https://laosbustickets.com/laos-transport-map/. Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors.

related.title: Laos border checkpoints (official register, updated weekly)

items.title: Thailand transport map: main roads, rail and ferry lines, airports and border crossings
description: Map of Thailand's main rail, road and ferry corridors, airports and land border crossings with Laos, Cambodia, Malaysia and Myanmar, with the status of each crossing. Checked every week against official sources; a new version is published here whenever the map changes.

Free to share under CC BY 4.0: credit "Thailand Transport Hub (thailandtransporthub.com)" with a link to https://thailandtransporthub.com/thailand-transport-map/. Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors, Natural Earth.

items.title: Vietnam transport map: trains, buses, ferries and border crossings
description: Map of Vietnam's rail line, main bus corridors, ferry piers, airports and the international land border crossings with Laos, Cambodia and China, with which ones accept the Vietnamese e-visa. Checked every week against official sources; a new version is published here whenever the map changes.

Free to share under CC BY 4.0: credit "Vietnam Transport Guide (vietnamtransportguide.com)" with a link to https://vietnamtransportguide.com/vietnam-transport-map/. Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors.

items.title: Cambodia transport map: buses, trains, ferries and border crossings
description: Map of Cambodia's bus routes, railway, ferry piers, airports and the international land border crossings with Vietnam, Laos and Thailand, with the status of each crossing. Checked every week against official sources; a new version is published here whenever the map changes.

Free to share under CC BY 4.0: credit "Cambodia Transport Guide (cambodiatransportguide.com)" with a link to https://cambodiatransportguide.com/cambodia-transport-map/. Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors, Natural Earth.

items.title: Philippines transport map: inter-island ferries, ports and airports
description: Map of the main inter-island ferry routes, ferry ports, bus and van lines and airports with flights between the islands. Checked every week against operator sources; a new version is published here whenever the map changes.

Free to share under CC BY 4.0: credit "Philippines Transport (philippinestransport.com)" with a link to https://philippinestransport.com/philippines-transport-map/. Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors.
